description: OFAC sanctions name screening for KYC/AML/KYB: fuzzy match a person, company, vessel or aircraft name against every primary name and alias on the U.S. Treasury OFAC SDN and Consolidated (non-SDN) lists. Accent, word-order and suffix tolerant. Up to 10 names (names=A|B). Returns verdict, score, list, programs, DOB, countries, official link. 400 invalid input. PAID: $0.001 USDC per call on Base via x402 (MCP transport: retry with params._meta["x402/payment"]). Same tool over plain HTTP: GET /v1/sanctions/name.

birthYear.description: optional 4-digit birth year to flag birthYearMatch on hits

country.description: optional country (e.g. Cuba) to flag countryMatch on hits

name.description: person, company, vessel or aircraft name (any word order, e.g. 'Maduro Moros, Nicolas')

names.description: alternative to name: up to 10 names separated by |

type.description: restrict to one entry type, default any

name: sanctions_name_screen
title: OFAC sanctions name screening (SDN + Consolidated, fuzzy)
